summary: Anthropic describes a collaboration with Mozilla in which Claude Opus 4.6 autonomously discovered 22 Firefox vulnerabilities (14 high-severity) over two weeks and was tested on its ability to write exploits for the bugs it found.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a frontier model autonomously and rapidly finding novel high-severity vulnerabilities in a hardened, well-tested codebase, a task threshold not previously demonstrated at this scale.
mechanisms.quote: AI models can now independently identify high-severity vulnerabilities in complex software.

mechanisms.reason: Claude operated as an autonomous agent scanning thousands of files, filing bug reports and proposing patches over an extended period without step-by-step human direction.
mechanisms.quote: By the end of this effort, we had scanned nearly 6,000 C++ files and submitted a total of 112 unique reports.
